title: Practice case studies — D2
purpose: Working sequence for Practice case studies: official cases, one-page designs, diagrams, ADRs, cost estimates, time-boxing, and architecture-framework critique.
routing_rationale: Use the D2 lens to keep official cases, one-page designs, diagrams, ADRs, cost estimates, time-boxing, and architecture-framework critique connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Turn a timed case prompt into a one-page design, diagram, ADR set, cost estimate, and peer critique.

nodes.label: Case Prompt
nodes.detail: The bounded case to solve under a time limit.

nodes.label: One-Page Design
nodes.detail: A concise design with a reason for each major choice.

nodes.label: Architecture Diagram
nodes.detail: A visual explanation of components and traffic paths.

nodes.label: ADR Set
nodes.detail: Decision records that preserve context and consequences.

nodes.label: Rough Cost Estimate
nodes.detail: A directional cost model that exposes its assumptions.

nodes.label: Peer Critique
nodes.detail: A review that tests trade-offs, risks, and missing evidence.

nodes.label: 30-Minute Timer
nodes.detail: The constraint that forces prioritisation and a defensible answer.

steps.title: Working sequence: One-Page Design → Architecture Diagram
steps.action: One-Page Design explain topology to Architecture Diagram; record evidence for official cases, one-page designs, diagrams, ADRs, cost estimates, time-boxing, and architecture-framework critique.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Practice case studies by making Architecture Diagram an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e2 for Practice case studies

steps.title: Working sequence: Architecture Diagram → ADR Set
steps.action: Architecture Diagram justify choices to ADR Set; record evidence for official cases, one-page designs, diagrams, ADRs, cost estimates, time-boxing, and architecture-framework critique.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Practice case studies by making ADR Set an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e3 for Practice case studies

steps.title: Working sequence: Architecture Diagram → Rough Cost Estimate
steps.action: Architecture Diagram price assumptions to Rough Cost Estimate; record evidence for official cases, one-page designs, diagrams, ADRs, cost estimates, time-boxing, and architecture-framework critique.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Practice case studies by making Rough Cost Estimate an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e4 for Practice case studies

scenarios.label: The case exceeds the time box
scenarios.root_cause: Research expands while the required design remains unfinished.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Practice case studies path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of 30-Minute Timer and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Write assumptions, time-box discovery, and move open questions to risks.

scenarios.label: The design cannot be explained visually
scenarios.root_cause: The diagram omits a dependency, boundary, or failure domain.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Practice case studies path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Architecture Diagram and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Trace every requirement through a node and an edge.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Architecture Diagram

scenarios.label: An ADR has no evidence
scenarios.root_cause: The recommendation is asserted without a rejected alternative or cost impact.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Practice case studies path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of ADR Set and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Add assumptions, evidence, consequences, and a verification date.

check.command: review d2 evidence for ADR Set
